description: This file is a PHP source script that implements a Smarty plugin function named 'assign_debug_info'. The function collects current Smarty template variables, configuration, and included templates, then assigns this debug information to the template for debugging purposes.

methods.name: smarty_function_assign_debug_info
methods.description: Defines the Smarty plugin function that gathers debug info and assigns it to the template variables for debugging purposes.
